title: Profit is not cash
caption: The month looked profitable, but the till was empty. Lumi tells Imran's story.
linkedin_text: ScoreMyBiz sets the profit the sales suggest against the cash the owner really has after what customers still owe and what he owes suppliers, and lists plain warnings from his own entries.

cast.imran: Imran, a middle-aged Indian hardware shop owner with grey-flecked hair and glasses, in a checked shirt with a pen in the pocket

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a navy blazer and white top, facing the camera in a hardware shop with shelves of tools and paint tins behind her, a warm smile.
scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Lumi. This is Imran's story. The month looked very profitable.
